core_courses.description: Introduction to programming using Python. Covers variables, control structures, functions, and basic data structures.
Object-oriented programming in Java. Covers classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and basic algorithms.
Fundamental data structures including arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, and graphs. Algorithm analysis.
Computer architecture, assembly language programming, memory organization, and I/O systems.
C programming, Unix/Linux systems, process management, memory management, and system calls.
Software engineering principles, agile development, version control, testing, and team projects.
Process scheduling, memory management, file systems, concurrency, and distributed systems.
Syntax, semantics, type systems, functional programming, and language implementation.
Algorithm design techniques, complexity analysis, NP-completeness, and advanced data structures.
First semester of senior capstone project. Project planning, requirements, and initial design.
Second semester of senior capstone. Implementation, testing, and final presentation.

electives.description: Network protocols, TCP/IP, routing, network security, and distributed applications.
Advanced software engineering topics, design patterns, and software architecture.
Development of mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms.
Full-stack web development including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and backend frameworks.
Finite automata, regular expressions, context-free grammars, and Turing machines.
Search algorithms, knowledge representation, machine learning fundamentals, and AI applications.
Supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, and practical ML applications.
Relational databases, SQL, database design, normalization, and transaction processing.
Data preprocessing, classification, clustering, association rules, and big data analytics.
Network security, cryptography, secure coding, and security protocols.

math_requirements.description: Functions, equations, inequalities, and polynomial operations.
Trigonometry, exponential and logarithmic functions, preparation for calculus.
Limits, derivatives, integrals, and applications of calculus.
Integration techniques, sequences, series, and parametric equations.
Logic, sets, relations, functions, combinatorics, and graph theory.
Vectors, matrices, linear transformations, eigenvalues, and applications.
Probability theory, random variables, distributions, and statistical inference.
